Page.Name: page.overlay.modal
Page.Title: Modal
Page.Subtitle: Rdialog_open shows any widget as a dialog of the window: here, documents of src/dialogs. Rdialog_close(button, result) closes the dialog holding the button; Escape dismisses it.

Button.Tooltip: Padding="0": the content touches the edges of the dialog
Padding="1": a hairline frame around an inner card
